description:
Cast Relentless Dead by paying {B}{B}.
When Relentless Dead enters the battlefield, Necroduality triggers, creating a token copy of it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Relentless Dead, adding {1}.
When Relentless Dead dies, its first and second abilities trigger. Choose not to pay for either.
Activate [[FSO]] by sacrificing the token Relentless Dead, adding {1}.
When the token Relentless Dead dies, its first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to pay {2} to return Relentless Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
